title: Mutoro Wechipo Chakarambwa
intro: Pakutanga kwenhoroondo yevanhu, nyika payakanga ichiri diki uye nyika yakagara pasi, mweya wakamira pamberi peMusiki nechipo chinozvininipisa. Chipo ichocho chakayerwa muchiyero chekugamuchirwa naMwari - uye chakawanikwa chisina kukwana. Chakatevera chaisava nyaya yekukanganwira, asi yemoyo wakadyiwa negodo, zvichitungamira kuchiito chisingachinjiki chaizogara chichidzokororwa. Iyi inyaya yemumwe ane zita rakafanana nekusaruramisira kwekutanga kwakakura kwakaitwa.
clues: Ndakavapo ndiri mumwe wevana vekutanga kuzvarwa, ndakaberekerwa nemubereki ane nyaya yaunoziva zvakanaka.
Ndakambopa chibayiro kuna Allah, asi hachina kugamuchirwa kubva kwandiri — kunyange zvazvo chipo chemukoma wangu chakagamuchirwa nenyasha.
Shanje nehasha zvakadzika midzi mumoyo mangu, uye ndakatyisidzira kugumisa hupenyu hwehama dzangu.
Mukoma wangu akandiyambira kuti nditye Allah, asi kuzvikudza kwangu kwakaramba kunditendera kuteerera.
Munguva yekuneta kukuru, ndakaita chiito chisingatsananguriki pahama yangu.
Mushure mezvo, handina kana kuziva kuti ndovanza sei zvandakanga ndaita — kusvikira chisikwa chepasi chatumirwa kuzondidzidzisa.

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
